caption: The drawing depicts a woman standing and facing forward. She has long, black hair that is parted in the middle and styled simply. She is wearing a dress with a fitted, off-the-shoulder bodice and wide, bell-shaped skirt. The dress is primarily light blue with a geometric diamond pattern and is decorated with white lace along the edges, including the neckline, sleeves, and hem of the skirt. Pink bows are placed on the center of the neckline, at the waist, and on both sleeves just above the elbows. A large pink sash is also tied at the waist, with the ends hanging down the front of the skirt. Beneath the skirt, white pantaloons with eyelet lace trim are visible, extending to just above the ankles. She wears black, low-heeled shoes with ankle straps. The background of the drawing is plain and uncolored, and the artist's signature, "Edith Turner," is located in the lower right corner.
title: Doll - "Delight Bates"
